        self.assertMatches("x", ["0.0.0", "1.2.3"], True)
        self.assertMatches("X", ["0.0.0", "1.2.3"], True)

    def test_empty_set_in_union_matches_everything(self):
        self.assertTrue(satisfies("3.0.0", "1.0.0 ||"))

    def test_primitives(self):
        self.assertMatches("<1.2.3", ["1.2.2"], True)
        self.assertMatches("<1.2.3", ["1.2.3", "1.2.4"], False)
        self.assertMatches("<=1.2.3", ["1.2.3"], True)

        self.assertMatches(">=1.2.3", ["1.2.3"], True)
        self.assertMatches("=1.2.3", ["1.2.3"], True)
        self.assertMatches("1.2.3", ["1.2.3"], True)
        self.assertMatches("1.2.3", ["1.2.4"], False)

    def test_whitespace_between_operator_and_version(self):
        self.assertTrue(satisfies("1.5.0", ">= 1.2.3"))
        self.assertTrue(satisfies("1.5.0", ">= 1.2.3 < 2"))
        self.assertFalse(satisfies("2.0.0", ">= 1.2.3 < 2"))

        self.assertMatches(">=1.2.3-alpha.1 <1.3.0", ["1.2.3-alpha.7"], True)
        self.assertMatches(">=1.2.3-alpha.1 <1.3.0", ["1.2.4-alpha.1"], False)

        self.assertTrue(satisfies("1.2.3-beta.1", "1.2.3-beta.0 || >=1.0.0 <2 >=1.2.3-beta.0"))

        for bad in [">=", "^", "1.x.3", "1.2.3 - ", "- 1.2.3", "01.2.3", ">=1 - 2", "1.2.3-"]:

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2", "^1.0.0")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):

    def test_excludes_prereleases_unless_matched(self):
        self.assertEqual(max_satisfying(["1.4.0", "1.5.0-beta"], "^1"), "1.4.0")
        self.assertEqual(max_satisfying(["1.4.0", "1.5.0-beta"], ">=1.5.0-alpha <2"), "1.5.0-beta")

        self.assertIsNone(max_satisfying([], "*"))

    def test_accepts_generator_and_orders_prereleases(self):
        result = max_satisfying((v for v in ["1.0.0-alpha.2", "1.0.0-alpha.10", "1.0.0-alpha.1"]),
